description: Add/subtract, count or find business days across countries and subdivisions; list public holidays. Bundled 2024–2030 calendars, inclusive ranges, explicit weekends and closures, source attribution and coverage warnings. See /calendar/coverage. Paid per call: $0.01 in USDC via x402.

additionalClosures.description: Closure dates applied to every requested calendar.

countries.description: Country or subdivision keys from /calendar/coverage, e.g. GB-ENG, DE-BY, US-NY.

days.description: Required for add. Start excluded except when days=0.

end.description: Required for count/intersection/holidays. Inclusive; at most 366 days.

weekend.description: ISO weekdays, Monday=1; default [6,7]. Applies to all calendars.

name: business-days
